images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production game sprite atlas, square transparent PNG, exact 2 by 2 grid of four equal square cells, for a gentle funny summoning game MARU MAGIC.
Primary request: Four small lovable magical spirits in a cohesive tactile storybook illustration style with soft gouache texture, crisp silhouettes, warm expressive faces. Top left: an asymmetrical potato spirit, tan lumpy potato body, tiny sprout crown, stubby feet, comically pompous proud expression, tiny golden cape. Top right: a round mint-green frog spirit, plump cheeks, cheerful big eyes, tiny feet and smiling face. Bottom left: a golden five-point star spirit with a happy face and tiny luminous sparkling accents. Bottom right: a pearl-white luminous light spirit, small round teardrop-shaped body with arms, serene happy eyes, gold halo, two graceful glowing wings. No other characters.
Composition: each character exactly centered at 25%/25%, 75%/25%, 25%/75%, 75%/75% respectively; same scale; each fits entirely inside central 70% of its own quadrant with generous clear margins, no overlap across quadrant boundaries, full bodies. No visible grid lines. Only these four sprites on actual alpha transparency, no ground, no shadow rectangles, no backgrounds. No text, numbers, labels, logos, watermark. Readable and charming on a dark midnight blue game canvas. Each cell is a separate isolated sprite, suitable for direct atlas frame rendering.
